capabilities: create files in a chosen folder with optional date prefix/suffix in the name
create files from Markdown, PDF, Base, and Excalidraw templates
generate Kanban boards with configurable column headers
bulk-create files for unresolved links after confirming a list
embed newly created files into an existing note
extras: Not yet in the Community Plugins store (pending approval); install via BRAT. The author states the plugin is 'vibe coded' (AI-generated) and it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Includes a built-in CSS snippet editor that can be disabled.
problem: Obsidian's default new-note flow offers limited file types, no per-folder template or date handling, and no bulk way to create files for links that point to notes that don't exist yet.

relations.evidence: Works with the Kanban plugin format
Works seamlessly with the Excalidraw plugin

summary: File creation tool that makes Markdown, PDF, Kanban, Base, and Excalidraw files in chosen folders, with templates, date prefixes, and bulk creation of unresolved-link files.
